verdict.rationale: Inline code completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair axis for an in-editor AI coding assistant like Cline, but nothing in the evidence documents ghost-text completions or next-edit prediction as you type. The documented features are agentic: approved file edits shown as diffs, Plan/Act modes, CLI and Kanban. Those are different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
